headline: Contested Sectors Stir as Main Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger has shifted its weight toward MooringCountyHex and StonecradleHex. Mooring recorded fourteen strategic-base events in twenty-four hours, including three in the latest two, and remains entirely Warden-held; casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating. Stonecradle, split five Colonial bases to four Warden, posted thirteen events—five in the latest two—with both sides’ casualty rates and enlistments rising sharply. WeatheredExpanseHex remains heavily engaged but has quieted at the base ledger: twenty-seven daily events, none in the latest two hours, while its four-Warden, five-Colonial division persists amid very high accelerating casualties. FishermansRowHex also cooled, with thirty-two daily events but none in the latest two and all nine bases Colonial. LinnMercyHex retains a ten-to-one Colonial majority; its fifteen daily events have gone quiet recently, though two-hour casualty rates remain substantial. StlicanShelfHex is still divided five Warden to four Colonial, with fourteen daily events but no fresh movement in the latest two hours. Elsewhere, NevishLineHex and CallahansPassageHex show surging combat and enlistment activity without recorded base changes.
